maudhui: (1) There shall be a commission for advising on the appointment of Judges and employment of Magistrates of courts in Mainland Tanzania which in this Constitution shall be known as the “Judicial Service Commission”. (2) The members of the Commission shall be: (a) the Chief Justice, who shall be Chairman; (b) the Attorney General; (c) one Judge of the Court of Appeal appointed for that purpose by the President after consultation with the Chief Justice; (d) the Principal Judge; and (e) two members appointed by the President. (3) A person shall not be appointed a member of the Commission under paragraph (e) of subarticle (2) if that person is a Member of Parliament or holds any other office prescribed for that purpose by a law enacted by Parliament. (4) In performing its functions, the Commission may delegate its functions to various committees established in accordance with a law enacted by Parliament.
